title: Single hero product or a range of 1-5 products
when: The home page sells one thing and explains it.

steps.when: a short flat menu and a left-aligned look (journal, dense catalog)

variants.when: a flat menu of up to 6-8 short items: the categories show on desktop
a nested or long menu that would not fit as links

steps.when: one strong text-free image, full height on phones (journal, premium, dark drop)
steps.note: Immersive, live headline, one button to the product.

variants.when: the merchant has a short silent loop with its own phone cut
a designed first screen: headline, button and photo composed in the markup (kit-custom-sections)

steps.when: 1-5 products: all formats as large cards

variants.when: bigger cards for the second source, a change of rhythm

steps.when: the default story: eyebrow, a heading phrase, 16 px text at 560-640 px, a button to a real page, a 1:1 or 3:4 photo (`mediaRatio`; kit-custom-sections)
steps.note: First chapter: what the product is and how it is used; a button or a last-line link to the product page.

variants.when: native fallback: an image-and-text stack the merchant edits in the cabinet (then `zigzag-next-right` for the second chapter)

steps.when: the default story: eyebrow, a heading phrase, 16 px text at 560-640 px, a button to a real page, a 1:1 or 3:4 photo (`mediaRatio`; kit-custom-sections)
steps.note: Second chapter, the photo on the other side: why it works, with a link on.

variants.when: after a native `zigzag-first`: the second chapter with the image on the right

steps.when: considered purchases: 3-4 real numbers (years, customers, materials) (kit-custom-sections)
steps.note: The signature block: one block that only this store has, chosen by the look (references/looks.md).

variants.when: the merchant has short vertical videos (kit-custom-sections)
premium and beauty: one real review set large (kit-custom-sections)
native fallback: text cards alternating with photos

steps.when: customer photos, stores or press the merchant has

variants.when: one strong real review with a name and a photo (kit-custom-sections)
service answers as untitled rows under the last grid (left-aligned themes)
a rounded theme (playful, soft): the questions on one card

steps.when: a centred form on a neutral band (centred themes)

variants.when: text left, form right: the usual closing band
on the footer palette, so the subscription and the footer read as one closing block
off-white, grey or cream: soft and premium looks

notes: `typography-display-left` (5xl) assumes a condensed or display face: change the font in the cabinet theme editor first. With the default or a humanist sans keep `typography-centred-3xl` or `typography-left-3xl` instead.

deviations.category-entry: There are no categories to enter.
